symptom: 镜头 N 在媒体左下，生成前后标题位置不一致
direct_cause: ShotPreviewOverlays bottom-1.5, header top-10px, image title bottom-2 independently overlay media
class_root: No shared outside-media layout boundary owns persistent metadata and toolbar clearance
affected_population: Mounted reference cards and active status
Large canvases with more than 80 nodes using lightweight previews

external_sources.purpose: Pointer enter/leave and subtree focus handling for native video controls.

invariants: Persistent metadata remains above media; toolbar remains above metadata at every supported zoom.
generality_proof: Standard empty/image/video nodes and lightweight large-canvas previews reuse NodeLabelRow, which places persistent metadata outside the media; no independent in-media title/status positioning remains in these bodies.

shared_boundaries.responsibility: Place and clip one metadata row outside media; hide at overview zoom.
Native controls only while pointer/focus is inside; renderer tests cover both input methods.
Scene metadata remains hidden outside hover/edit interaction.

same_class_entry_points.evidence: Empty shot uses same outer row as generated result.
Generated image and video branches share the outer metadata row.
Scene card uses its dedicated media body; interaction-only metadata is tested in the shared Electron fixture.
Authorized single-file consolidation into NodeLabelRow; 81-node real-project regression exercises the LOD renderer and asserts zero persistent-text overlap.

recurrence.reason: Any result type or state transition can reproduce independently positioned overlays.
same_class_scan: rg ShotMountBadges / NodeGenerationStatus: common BaseGenerationNode header
Read components/LightweightGenerationNode.tsx and components/canvasNodeLevelOfDetail.ts: >80 nodes and zoom<0.55 bypass the standard body; route metadata through NodeLabelRow as well.

prevention.invariant: Metadata row bottom is above media top; toolbar bottom is above row top.
prevention.failure_mode: Long content is truncated inside a single bounded outside-media row; overview row is hidden.
prevention.strategy: Move existing metadata into the common outside-media row and remove per-child absolute placement.

legacy_paths.rationale: Remove bottom-left shot/mount positioning and generated-only bottom-right title positioning. Remove the lightweight body bottom title/status overlay in favor of the same shared row.

dependency_lifecycle.rationale: Existing React/CSS composition only, no dependency behavior changed.

migration: No data change; existing nodes render through common row.
residual_risks: Actual React Flow viewport clamps requested 20% to upstream minZoom 50%; reactFlow/** is frozen. Host fixture 20% is proven, actual viewport 20% is not. C09 留给 #646 合后。

invariant_owner_layer.why: Shared node chrome owns persistent metadata geometry for all media branches.
